en: Melting changes solid ice to liquid water using heat, while dissolving mixes solid sugar into liquid water without heating.
A massive steel ship floats because its hollow shape lowers its overall density below that of water.
Boiling water stays at exactly 100 degrees Celsius until all the liquid turns into water vapor gas.
A fully inflated basketball weighs slightly more than a deflated one because the trapped air inside has mass.
Puddles evaporate into water vapor on cool days because evaporation occurs at the liquid surface at any temperature.
Aluminum and copper are common metals, but they are not attracted to magnets like iron, nickel, or cobalt.
You can separate a mixture of iron filings and sand using a magnet without causing any chemical change.
Mixing baking soda and vinegar causes a chemical change that produces invisible carbon dioxide gas bubbles.
Air is a homogeneous mixture of gases, meaning it is a gaseous solution containing nitrogen and oxygen.
A sealed glass of ice water weighs exactly the same before and after the ice cubes melt completely.
Evaporated water does not disappear but becomes an invisible gas called water vapor that mixes into the air.
Gases like the helium inside a balloon can flow and take the shape of their container, just like liquids.
